profiles.description: Owns the renewal book within the Underwriting division's Renewals department, driving the Submission-to-Bind / Underwriting value stream for expiring accounts. The role generates prioritized renewal worklists, reassesses each account against current underwriting appetite, recalculates renewal premium against current rating tables, and issues renewal quotes with revised terms and conditions. It leads broker-facing retention work — presenting renewal terms and rationale, logging counter-proposals, and coordinating quote preparation between producer and underwriting — and supports at-risk account save plays. It also participates in MGA delegated-authority oversight, monitoring binding-limit compliance and loss-ratio performance, and its deliverables extend to mid-term endorsements, non-renewal/cancellation management, and policy reinstatement.

sources.title: Insurance Underwriter Job Description | Velvet Jobs
Insurance Underwriter Job Description [Workable]

profiles.notes: Velvet Jobs confirms renewal underwriters manage renewal expiration lists, calculate projected renewal ratings, and negotiate with brokers — matching the packet's Owner tasks. Participant relation on MGA delegated-authority tasks is consistent with oversight normally owned by a delegated-authority/portfolio function. Lead relation on Sales Distribution Marketing is broader than typical for this title but reflects the packet's broker-negotiation and retention scope.

profiles.description: Builds and operates the reporting layer in the Data & AI division's Analytics Delivery department, serving underwriting, claims, finance, and technology stakeholders. The role designs dashboard wireframes, builds curated reporting datasets from the semantic model, develops visuals with interactive filters, and publishes dashboards with row-level access permissions so users see only authorized books of business. It owns reconciliation of dashboard figures against system-of-record totals and supports regulatory and actuarial reporting analytics plus refresh/operations management. A distinctive slice of the portfolio is cloud FinOps reporting — executive cloud cost trend dashboards, per-team showback statements, and unit-cost trending — alongside self-service analytics enablement and adoption monitoring.

profiles.description: Estimates and monitors claim liabilities for this multi-line carrier from the Actuarial division's Reserving department, leading the Actuarial and Reinsurance value streams. The role runs mortality/longevity and morbidity experience studies end to end — extracting in-force and claims data, computing actual-to-expected ratios by risk cell, fitting and graduating mortality improvement rates, and drafting assumption recommendations. It estimates IBNR using development factors and Bornhuetter-Ferguson, supports life and annuity statutory valuation (PBR) and GAAP LDTI reserving, and values outstanding reserves and ceded liabilities for reinsurance and retrocession commutations. Deliverables span reserve setting and booking, reserve adequacy review and the actuarial opinion, ceded reserve management, and reserve development monitoring, with quarterly reserve committee and finance close support.

profiles.notes: O*NET confirms actuaries ascertain 'cash reserves and liabilities necessary to ensure payment of future benefits' and run mortality/morbidity experience analysis; Axxima confirms IBNR estimation via development-factor and Bornhuetter-Ferguson methods. Credentialed professional IC role; senior in expertise but not a people-leadership position in this packet.

profiles.description: Leads the carrier's business continuity and operational resilience program: conducting business impact analyses to identify critical business functions, developing and maintaining continuity plans, exercising continuity scenarios, and reporting continuity readiness to management. The role coordinates across underwriting, claims, operations, and technology to keep recovery capabilities current and validated through drills and scenario tests. Its packet has no wired process nodes yet, so scope is defined by its four responsibilities, which map directly to the standard BIA-plan-exercise-report continuity lifecycle.

proposedOrgUnit.rationale: Business continuity/resilience is an operations function at this carrier and the org catalog has a dedicated Vendor & Resilience department under Operations & Customer Service.

profiles.notes: Prior tagged Specialist / Individual Contributor; both fetched sources treat business continuity/resilience manager as a manager-level, management-track role (Velvet Jobs: 5+ years managerial capacity), and the title heuristic agrees, so Manager is used and the prior disagreement recorded. Operations is a vocab stretch (no dedicated Resilience family); Specialist would be the alternative. Confidence medium because the packet has zero tasks, value streams, or deliverables.

profiles.description: Runs day-to-day retirement plan administration in the Operations & Customer Service division's Policy Operations department, leading the Retirement Plan Administration value stream for the carrier's retirement services business. The role processes plan contributions, loans, distributions, and rollovers within service standards, reconciles payroll contribution files against plan records, and administers plan-level transactions such as fund changes, vesting updates, and forfeitures. It supports annual compliance testing, Form 5500 filings, and required participant notices, responds to plan sponsor and participant inquiries, and coordinates corrections for failed transactions and operational errors under EPCRS guidance.

profiles.notes: Both sources confirm the contribution/loan/distribution processing, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500, and notice duties in the packet responsibilities. profiles.description: Maintains the participant-level books of the carrier's retirement recordkeeping platform, supporting the Retirement Plan Administration value stream from the Policy Operations department. The role keeps participant account records, balances, and money sources current; posts daily trade, contribution, and distribution activity and resolves processing breaks; and reconciles units and cash between recordkeeping, trust, and fund company records. It processes participant data changes, beneficiary updates, and vesting recalculations, produces participant statements and plan sponsor reports on schedule, and supports QDRO processing, force-out distributions, and required minimum distribution calculations.

Support relation on the value stream fits the recordkeeper's back-office position relative to the plan administrator. Confidence medium because the packet has no wired tasks or deliverables.

profiles.description: Owns retrocession strategy and execution for the assumed book from the Reinsurance division's Retrocession department, leading the Reinsurance & Retrocession Management value stream. The role analyzes assumed-book accumulation and net PML, defines retention and protection objectives by line of business, and structures proportional, cat, and whole-account retro programs — optimizing cat layer attachment and limit configuration and documenting recommended structures for management approval. It designs alternative-capital solutions (cat bond trigger structures, sidecar quota-share ceding and profit-sharing terms, investor disclosure packages) and runs the placement cycle end to end: distributing submissions to the retrocessionaire panel, evaluating quotes and rate-on-line indications, and negotiating signed lines. Deliverables extend to retro collateral and trust structuring, commutation management, retrocessionaire credit monitoring, and spiral/concentration control reporting, in support of Finance, Treasury & Capital Management.

profiles.notes: Artemis confirms modern retro programs blend indemnity protection with ILS/cat bond/collateralized capacity, matching the packet's alternative-capital design tasks; Hannover Re shows the function organized as a dedicated specialist team spanning structuring through investor relations. Manager per title and single-function ownership; not VP-level in the packet.

profiles.description: Supports the enterprise risk management framework from the Risk, Compliance & Audit division's Enterprise Risk department, leading Risk Compliance Audit value-stream work and supporting the PMO. The role maintains the risk universe — mapping business processes and entities to risk taxonomy nodes and reconciling risk register entries against the active taxonomy — and assesses inherent and residual risk for identified regulatory obligations. It executes stress testing and scenario analysis (sourcing and validating input data, running calculations, quantifying impacts) supporting ORSA and capital adequacy reporting, scans external sources for emerging risk signals onto the horizon-scanning heat map, and compiles KRI trends and breach status for risk committee MI. Deliverables also cover operational risk and control self-assessment, loss event capture and root-cause analysis, and insurance risk appetite and accumulation monitoring.

profiles.notes: Prior (Risk & Compliance / IC) confirmed: Velvet Jobs describes the enterprise risk analyst as an early-to-mid-career IC monitoring KRIs and risk registers, and NY DFS confirms ORSA stress-testing/capital-adequacy reporting as a regulatory requirement the analyst supports. The Customer Due Diligence & KYC deliverable sits closer to financial-crime compliance than enterprise risk but does not contradict any Owner/Participant assignment.

profiles.description: Provides technical risk assessment for underwriting from the Underwriting division's Specialty Support department, leading in the Underwriting and Risk Compliance Audit value streams. The core engineering work is assessing physical hazard through risk engineering reviews, validating that inspection and loss-control prerequisites are cleared before bind, and contributing subjectivities, warranties, and risk improvement conditions to terms determination — classic carrier loss-control work of site surveys, hazard documentation, and remediation tracking with insureds, brokers, and underwriters. Unusually for the title, this instantiation also owns a controls-testing portfolio: scoping SOX key controls from materiality assessment, documenting control deficiencies and severity, and identifying in-scope systems and ITGC control domains, plus participant roles in change risk-tier assessment and important-business-service classification.

Description follows the packet and includes both scopes; the Owner flags record the contradiction.

profiles.description: Provides the analytical engine for distribution strategy in the Sales, Distribution & Marketing division's Distribution Analytics department, leading the Sales Distribution Marketing value stream. The role quantifies addressable premium opportunity per channel-segment cell, builds cost-to-acquire/cost-to-serve models and channel-level CLV and contribution margin, analyzes premium potential and producer density for territory design and capacity planning, and monitors cross-channel overlap and cannibalization. It also powers the producer lifecycle: building target producer prospect lists against territory white space, screening prospective agency books and loss-ratio history, producing producer compliance monitoring summaries, tracking training/certification completion, and monitoring early-life producer engagement metrics such as time to first bind. Deliverables extend to sales planning and quota administration and distribution sales operations support.

The 'Approve or recommend policy changes' responsibility reads senior for an analyst title but the task set is clearly IC analytical work.

profiles.description: Coordinates salvage recovery on total-loss vehicles, equipment, and damaged property from the Claims division's Claims Recoveries & Litigation department, supporting the Claims value stream. The role initiates salvage assignments, secures titles, lien releases, and owner-retention paperwork for lawful disposal, files salvage or branded titles with state DMVs, and coordinates towing, storage, and auction logistics with salvage vendors to minimize storage fees. It sets salvage reserve estimates from expected auction proceeds, reconciles auction proceeds against the claim file, documents environmental and hazardous-material disposal compliance, and tracks salvage return ratios and vendor performance — while ensuring title branding and reporting comply with state DMV and federal NMVTIS requirements.

profiles.description: Facilitates agile delivery for squads in the Product, Delivery & PMO division's Agile Delivery department, leading in the Product Delivery and PMO value streams. The role defines team-level Definition of Done and story acceptance standards, facilitates story-point estimation, confirms sprint capacity and commits the sprint backlog, and runs lessons-learned retrospectives at sprint, project, and stage-gate closure — feeding the knowledge management repository. It administers agile tooling, configuring Azure Boards work item types, workflow states, and templates, and onboards new squad members to agile ways of working. It also participates in demand shaping and initiative intake: logging new requests, drafting high-level scope with t-shirt-size estimates, and triaging qualified demand to intake committees.

profiles.description: Runs vulnerability management and security operations from the Cybersecurity & IAM division's Cyber Operations department, leading the Cybersecurity IAM value stream. The role owns the vulnerability lifecycle: executing scheduled authenticated scans across the estate, deduplicating and normalizing findings against the asset register, triaging false positives, enriching findings with exploit availability and threat intel, verifying post-patch closure via rescans, and compiling remediation SLA and aging KPIs. It also carries SOC and defensive-engineering duties — isolating affected systems during containment, preserving forensic evidence, running configuration compliance scans against hardening baselines, and investigating WAF-blocked attacks and tuning signatures. Deliverables span detection engineering, alert triage, endpoint security, and security monitoring and event collection across the carrier's insurance platforms.

profiles.description: Executes the technical accounting close from the Finance & Investments division's Financial Control department, with reach into actuarial, technology, and PMO value streams. The role posts booked reserve journal entries to the general ledger, records earned premium recognition and premium receivables, reconciles agent/broker accounts and billing-to-ledger balances, and extracts closed-period actuals for management reporting and variance analysis. It owns cost allocation and transfer pricing — running allocation cycles, calculating intercompany charges, and resolving recipient disputes — and reconciles technology chargeback amounts to the GL. The scope includes LDTI-adjacent work (participating in fair-value measurement of market risk benefits), statutory and GAAP reporting support, SOX control execution with audit evidence, and subledger close and fixed asset accounting.

profiles.description: Handles the most sensitive and escalated policyholder interactions in the Operations & Customer Service division's Customer Service department, within the Business Operations value stream. Beyond resolving escalated billing, claims-status, and policy-change calls across P&C, life, and retirement product lines, this instantiation owns two specialized workflows: conservation outreach to lapse-pending life policyowners (supporting reinstatement to in-force status) and beneficiary location and outreach due diligence under Death Master File matching and escheatment. The role mentors and coaches junior agents on call handling and product knowledge, documents interactions and complaints in the CRM, escalates regulatory complaint trends to compliance, and verifies caller identity per privacy procedures before disclosing account information.
